column1: # Source: Cevrim et al. 2025 (bioRxiv 2025.10.08.681007), human dotplot figure.
# NOTE: this is NOT a gene-for-gene translation of panel_mouse.tsv. The published
# human panel uses different markers (EPCAM/KLF5 for epithelium, the COL5A1/
# COL6A3/DCN block for fibroblasts, LEFTY2/IGFBP1 for decidual). Do not assume a
# shared marker list across species -- the mouse decidual marker Prl8a2 has no
# human ortholog (rodent-expanded placental prolactin family; human decidual
# prolactin is simply PRL, which the published human panel does not use).
# role          lineage = used for scoring/assignment; context = plotted only.
# Row order sets the dotplot row order (matches the published figure).
